title: FireSettings
description: Data file content/fire/settings.json (B5 R45-R47, step B5-10, D1084): how things dry after rain, that wet things do not burn, how a fire takes hold of dry burnable things near it and what is left when a fire burns down. All numbers are data; the code knows no fire and no material by name. Calm world: a cap on new fires per check and on burning things on the island (no wildfire), no harm to inhabitants (B2472).

fuel_property.description: The TRUE property that makes a thing catch fire and feed one (vocabulary property).

drying.description: How long a thing stays wet after the last rain on the island, by the air temperature at its place: the first band whose below_tenth_c is above the temperature applies; the last band (below_tenth_c null) takes the rest. Wet things neither catch fire nor feed one.

spread.description: A fire takes hold of dry burnable things near it. Absent = fires never spread.

felt.description: B5 R47: a sensation the inhabitants feel near fire - this many burning things within the radius (a campfire alone is not a big fire).

remains.description: What a fire leaves where it burnt down (not when rain put it out): the burnt type and what is left.

below_tenth_c.description: Upper bound of the band (air temperature in tenths of a degree), null = no bound.

hours.description: Game hours a thing stays wet after the last rain.

every_minutes.description: How often, in game minutes, each fire may take hold of something near it.

radius_cm.description: Reach of a fire: the chance falls off linearly to nothing at this distance.

chance_permille.description: Chance per check for a dry burnable thing right at the fire.

wind_permille.description: Extra chance at full wind, in permille of the chance (wind 0..1 of the weather).

max_new.description: At most this many things catch fire in one check on the whole island.

max_burning.description: No fire takes hold while this many things burn on the island.

becomes.description: The type a thing turns into when it catches fire (a burning type of the catalog).

spares.description: Things with any of these TRUE properties never catch fire from a fire near them (review GW1 #396: what inhabitants built waits for the damage by quality, A1382 S2).

radius_cm.description: How near the burning things are.

min_burning.description: How many burning things at least.

left.description: The type left where it burnt down.
